Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In step 4, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly navigate to the IMDb profile page for Alain Resnais. Instead of opening the correct URL (which was visible in the search results as `https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0720297`), the agent opened the page for "Michael Wincott" (`https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0000699/`). This navigation error led to retrieving irrelevant birth data (Scarborough, Toronto) for the wrong person, forcing the Planner to restart the search process. Although the agent eventually found the correct data in subsequent steps (Step 6), this initial failure to click the correct link from the search results was the first critical error in the chain.
